item.title: Hisatsune grabs Pebble Beach lead
item.description: Ryo Hisatsune fired a career-best 10-under par 62 on Thursday to take a one-stroke first-round lead in the PGA Tour's Pebble Beach Pro-Am.

item.title: Reed to play in South African Open
item.description: Patrick Reed has confirmed that he will play in the Investec South African Open Championship at Stellenbosch Golf Club from 26 February to 1 March.

item.title: Rahm leads LIV Golf Adelaide, Saffa shares fifth
item.description: Jon Rahm moved into pole position at LIV Golf Adelaide with a superb bogey-free nine-under 63 in Friday’s second round at The Grange Golf Club.

item.title: Follet-Smith fires 60 to seize NTT Data lead
item.description: Zimbabwe’s Benjamin Follett-Smith raced to a 12-under 60 at Fancourt’s Outeniqua course to take control of the NTT Data Men’s Pro-Am.

item.title: Bhatia, Hisatsune share Pebble Beach lead, Fowler surges
item.description: Akshay Bhatia joined Ryo Hisatsune at the top of the PGA Tour's Pebble Beach Pro-Am leaderboard on 15 under par on Friday, with a resurgent Rickie Fowler hot on their heels.

item.title: Player frustrated by Augusta snub
item.description: Three-time Masters champion Gary Player has expressed his disappointment at being denied permission to play a fourball at Augusta National Golf Club with his grandsons.

item.title: DeChambeau, Rahm break clear in Adelaide
item.description: Star duo Job Rahm and Bryson DeChambeau lead by five shots and will decide LIV Golf’s marquee regular-season event in a direct showdown.

item.title: Sattelkau chasing back-to-back titles
item.description: Germany’s Celina Sattelkau takes a three-stroke lead into Sunday’s final round of the NTT DATA Ladies’ Pro-Am.

item.title: Els brings sunshine on cloudy Fancourt day
item.description: MJ Daffue surged to 13 under with a sparkling 64 to lead the NTT Data Men’s Pro-Am at Fancourt, while Ernie Els rolled back the years.

item.title: Bhatia grabs lead at breezy Pebble Beach
item.description: Akshay Bhatia birdied six of his first seven holes on the way to a four-under 68 to seize a two-shot lead after Saturday’s third round of the PGA Tour's Pebble Beach Pro-Am.
